Population increased in Dartford

The estimated population of Dartford in 2024 was 125,011 usual residents, a rise of 2.5% since 2023.

This meant that Dartford's rate of population change placed it among the 10 percent fastest growing local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Dartford increased by 7%.

Over this slightly longer period, Dartford was also among the 10% fastest growing local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of Dartford

The average (median) age rose to 37.3 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Dartford has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
Dartford is an area that is classed as urban in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, Dartford's population of 125,011 usual residents was made up of:

  • 28,565 people aged 0 to 15 years, (22.8%)
  • 79,691 people aged 16 to 64 years, (63.7%)
  • 16,755 people aged 65 years and over, (13.4%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Dartford has a lower proportion of people aged 65 years and over (13.4% compared with 18.9% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Dartford, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net international migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Dartford
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Dartford, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More births than deaths increased the population of 640 people (0.5%). In total, there were 1,526 births and 886 deaths in Dartford.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) increased the population by 788 (0.6%). There were 9,937 people entering the area and 9,149 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Dartford's population of 1,619 (1.3%) as a result of 2,199 people entering the area and 580 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Dartford was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Dartford in mid-2023 is 121,966.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 699 people and internal migration estimates were revised upwards by 568 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 1,267 people.
